title: Nova Agent Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Nova coding agent (v2). Supports layered merging: global (~/.config/nova/config.json) → project (.nova/config.json) → environment variables. JSON keys are camelCase; legacy snake_case keys are accepted for backward compatibility. Reasoning effort is controlled per-model via providers.<name>.models.<id>.reasoningEffort; the legacy top-level 'enableThinking' boolean was removed — Nova still parses and discards it for backward compatibility.

version.description: Semantic version of the configuration schema instance.

defaultModel.description: Primary model selection as '<provider>/<model-id>' (e.g., 'openai/gpt-5.5', 'ollama/llama3.1:8b', 'qwen-cloud/qwen3.7-plus'). The provider part is split on the first '/'; model ids may contain further slashes (e.g., 'huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B'). Both parts may contain ':', '+', '.', '_' and '-'. This is the single source of truth for provider + model. Legacy key 'model' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'defaultModel'.

baseURL.description: Override base URL for the active provider. Legacy key 'base_url' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'baseURL'.

useResponsesEndpoint.description: Use the OpenAI Responses API instead of Chat Completions. Legacy key 'use_responses_endpoint' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'useResponsesEndpoint'.

strictOutputs.description: Send OpenAI strict structured-outputs mode in tool definitions. Only works against the OpenAI API — gateways (OpenRouter/Ollama/vLLM/Together) reject or silently break it, disabling function-calling. Enable only when talking directly to OpenAI. Legacy key 'strict_outputs' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'strictOutputs'.

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt override. Legacy key 'system_prompt' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'systemPrompt'.

bashClassifierUrl.description: URL of the local bash command safety classifier endpoint. Legacy key 'bash_classifier_url' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'bashClassifierUrl'.

providers.description: Per-provider configuration keyed by provider name. Accepts builtin labels ('openai', 'ollama', 'openrouter', ...) and custom provider names ('qwen-cloud', 'my-endpoint'). Custom providers appear in the /connect picker and use the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

mcpServers.description: Model Context Protocol server integrations. Legacy keys 'mcp_servers' and 'mcp' are parsed for backward compatibility but are not schema-valid; new configs must use 'mcpServers'.

plugins.description: Lua plugin configuration keyed by plugin name. Each entry controls whether the plugin is enabled and its custom settings. Settings are passed to the plugin's Lua code via plugin.get_config().

context.description: Context window management and compaction policy.

toast.description: Toast notification settings (transient top-right TUI notices).

baseURL.description: Custom base URL for this provider. Legacy key 'base_url' is parsed for backward compatibility but is not schema-valid; new configs must use 'baseURL'.

models.description: Per-model configuration keyed by model id.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level for this model. 'default' sends no reasoning parameter (model decides); 'none' disables thinking explicitly.

contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens for this model. Overrides the catalogue lookup. Falls back to context.overrideContextWindow when unset.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens per generation turn for this model. Sent as max_tokens in the request body. Falls back to context.maxOutputTokens when unset.

reasoningOptions.description: Reasoning efforts this model supports. The TUI model picker filters its reasoning cycle to this list. Empty or absent means all efforts are available.

MCPServerConfig.description: A Model Context Protocol server. Exactly one transport must be configured: 'command' (+ optional 'args') for a local stdio subprocess, or 'url' for a remote server (Streamable HTTP, with legacy HTTP+SSE fallback). The two are mutually exclusive — providing both or neither is invalid, mirroring the transport union in src/config.zig.

type.description: Optional transport discriminator (e.g. 'stdio') for compatibility with other MCP clients. Nova infers the transport from 'command'/'url' and ignores this field.

command.description: Executable command for the stdio transport (local subprocess). Supports '{env:VAR}' placeholders, expanded from the process environment when the server connects.

args.description: Command arguments for the stdio transport. Supports '{env:VAR}' placeholders, expanded from the process environment when the server connects.

type.description: Optional transport discriminator (e.g. 'remote' or 'http') for compatibility with other MCP clients. Nova infers the transport from 'command'/'url' and ignores this field.

url.description: Endpoint URL for the remote transport (Streamable HTTP; legacy HTTP+SSE fallback). Must be http(s). Supports '{env:VAR}' placeholders (e.g. an API key), expanded from the process environment when the server connects.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request (e.g. an API key for servers that authenticate via headers, like Context7). Values support '{env:VAR}' placeholders, expanded from the process environment when the server connects; keep secrets in the environment, not config.json.

settings.description: Plugin-specific settings as a JSON object string (e.g. '{"theme":"dark"}'). The plugin's Lua code parses this via plugin.get_config().

overrideContextWindow.description: Explicit context window size in tokens. Overrides the model catalogue lookup (useful for local Ollama/LMStudio models).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens per single model generation turn.

maxParallelToolCalls.description: Upper bound on parallel tool calls accepted from the model. Providers exceeding this get a logged error.

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Socket read timeout in seconds for streaming responses. Prevents indefinite hangs when the server stops mid-stream.

maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum number of LLM requests in flight across ALL lanes at once. Each lane runs its own worker + HTTP client, so without this cap N active lanes fire N independent requests at the provider, which degrades or rate-limits the burst. 1 serializes requests.

disablePromptCache.description: Disable provider prompt-caching fields (message-level cache_control and top-level prompt_cache_key) entirely, in both the chat-completions and Responses API clients. Use for OpenRouter models that reject these fields with HTTP 400 (some :free / gateway-fronted models).

CompactionSettings.description: Automatic context summarization policy when approaching the model context window limit.

auto.description: Enable automatic context compaction before reaching limits.

threshold.description: Fraction of context window (0.1–0.9) that triggers background summarization. The swap watermark is derived as threshold + 0.20 (capped at 0.95); values above 0.9 are clamped at parse time so the swap watermark never falls below the start watermark.

keepRecentTokens.description: Recent conversation tokens retained verbatim alongside the generated summary. Scaled down proportionally for small-context models.

keepRecentToolTurns.description: Number of most recent tool-result turns kept in full when assembling each prompt. Older tool results are pruned to historicalToolCapBytes with a '[... compacted to save context ...]' notice. Raise this when an agentic turn needs earlier tool outputs in full (e.g. multi-phase skills). Minimum 1 — a value of 0 would prune every tool result and break tool-calling.

historicalToolCapBytes.description: Byte cap applied to tool results older than keepRecentToolTurns — the head is kept followed by a '[... compacted to save context (was N bytes) ...]' notice. Raise for large command outputs the model must re-read later in the same turn.

ToastSettings.description: Transient toast notifications shown in the top-right corner of the TUI. With the TUI running, warn+ log output routes to the toast bus instead of stderr (which would tear the frame); setting NOVA_LOG_STDERR_LEVEL restores the stderr channel. All fields are optional and omitted from config.json when left at defaults.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, no toasts are shown (warn+ output is dropped from the TUI; set NOVA_LOG_STDERR_LEVEL to route it back to stderr). Toggled live from the /settings General tab.

durationMs.description: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. Out-of-range values are dropped (left null) at parse time, not clamped, so a typo can't produce a toast that never dismisses. Config-file only — not surfaced in the settings panel.

maxVisible.description: Maximum number of toasts stacked at once. Out-of-range values are dropped at parse time. Config-file only — not surfaced in the settings panel.

position.description: Corner position. Reserved for future use: only 'top-right' is rendered today; other values are parsed and persisted but have no effect yet.
